headline: Southern New Hampshire outscore every programme in the division
dek: Southern New Hampshire's win at Pace keeps their season unbeaten, and no programme in the division has scored as many goals. Maryville, Midwestern State and Southwest Baptist are nearest to them, and of those only Midwestern State are also yet to lose.
displaced_by: results night: Southern New Hampshire's win at Pace leaves them with more goals than any other programme in the division
